kjv: that we should be called the sons of God
mine: that we should be called children of God; and so we are
note: TR omits "kai esmen" (and so we are; P74, Sinaiticus, A, B, C).

kjv: Whosoever is born of God doth not commit sin … he cannot sin
mine: No one born of God makes a practice of sinning … he cannot keep on sinning
note: Present tenses describe habitual action; the KJV's "cannot sin" seems to contradict 1:8–10 and has fed perfectionist readings.

kjv: Hereby perceive we the love [of God]
note: The KJV supplies "of God" (in italics); John defines love itself by Christ's self-giving.
